target: shes rab la spros pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le yang rdo rje nor bur gnas pa de'i gsang ba dang lte ba dang snying gar 'gyur med gsum du gyur pa gang yin pa de ni sgrub pa la zhes pa gsum pa sgrub pa'i yan lag la 'gyur ro/ / 'khor lo can gyi zhes pa gtsug tor gyi khro bo'i lta bas zhes pa mig mi 'dzums par steng du lta bas mtshan mar 'gyur te mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor gyis rnam pa bzhi dang nyin mo'i rnal 'byor gyis rnam pa drug ste de nas gzugs so/ / spros pa zla ba thig le ste shes rab la spros pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le rdo rje nor bur gnas pa de'i gsang ba lte ba dang snying gar 'gyur med gsum gyi rnal 'byor du 'gyur ba gang yin pa de yang sgrub pa la 'gyur ro zhes pa gsum bsgrub pa'i yan lag la 'gyur te/
src_sentence: iha prajñārāgena sṛṣṭaścāsāvindubinduśca sṛṣṭendubindustasya prajñāsṛṣṭabodhicittavibandorapi kuliśamaṇau gatasya yarūyakṣaro yogo bhavati guhye nābhau hṛdaye sa sādhane syāditi sādhanāṅge tṛtīye bha- vati

head: kṛ
target: dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor 'dir ni sa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin te de'i yon tan dbang gis so zhes pa 'chad par 'gyur ba las brjod par bya'o/ / de ltar rgyud gzhan thams cad la nges pa'o/ / rnam bkra mchod pa byas te gzhan pa rnam bcu rnams kyang bdag nyid nus pas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin/ / slob dpon dag gi zhabs kyi rtsa bar mchog gi bu yis yon ni dag pa'i slad du dbul bar bya/ /

target: de bzhin du phreM gi yi ge ni sna tshogs yum gyi sa bon no/ / de la 'di ni cho ga ste khrus byas shing gos gtsang ma bgos te zhi ba la sogs pa'i las dang rjes su mthun pa'i sa de nyid maN+Dal byas nas shar du mngon par phyogs pa la u dum+WA ra'i so shing dam 'o ma can gyi shing gzhan las skyes pa sor bcu gnyis pa mgo bor me tog gi phreng ba bcings pa dri la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod nas sngags 'dis sbyin par bya'o/ /
src_sentence: snātasya dhautavastrasya śāntyādikarmānusāreṇa tasyāmeva bhūmyāṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvodumbaraṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ dvādaśāṅgulamanyakṣīravṛkṣajaṃ vā śirasi puṣpamālāṃ badhchā gandhādibhirarcayitvā pūrvābhimukhasya deyamanena mantreṇa |

head: oṃ
target: hrA~M yig la sogs yan lag drug po o~M yig dang por gyur pa dang ldan pa ni bzlas pa'i don du bcom ldan 'das kyi nye ba'i snying po ste/ oM a A aM aHbadzra satwa ma hA su kha badzra kA la tsakra shi Sh+ya s+yA b+hi mu kho b+ha ba sa na tuSh+To b+ha ba ba ra do b+ha ba kA ya wAka tsit+tA d+hiSh+ThA nAM ku ru ku ru swA hA/
